name: @pixeldojo/mcp

tools.name: pixeldojo_generate
tools.description: Generate an image or video from a prompt with any model in the PixelDojo catalog. With no `model`, a prompt runs on seedream-5, which makes still images only. For a video, name seedance-2-5, which works from a prompt alone or a starting image. If a provider refuses the content, retry once on wan-3-0-video (video) or seedream-5 (images), the least-restricted models. For a multi-shot film or a music video synced to a song use pixeldojo_film; to change, move or extend an existing clip use pixeldojo_video. These are the models the PixelDojo studios use; name another only when the user asks for it. References: `image_url`/`image_urls` for stills, `video_url` for a source clip, `image_path`/`image_paths` for absolute local files (uploaded to 24h temp storage first). A clip or an audio track URL with no `model` runs on seedance-2-reference; a named model that cannot read a clip is swapped for it and the result says so, while a named model with no audio input drops the track. Model-specific settings go in `params` alongside an explicit `model`. Returns asset URLs, or a jobId for pixeldojo_status when the job outlasts the 30s wait.

prompt.description: Prompt describing what to generate. Write @Name to use a character or element the user saved in Character Studio ("@Mara on a beach"): its photos are attached automatically on models that take reference images. pixeldojo_library source=characters lists them.

model.description: Model apiId. Recommended (the models the PixelDojo studios use): "seedream-5" for images (the default), "seedance-2-5" for video (prompt only or a starting image), "wan-3-0-video" for video the others refuse. Use another model only when the user names one. Full catalog: https://pixeldojo.ai/api/v1/models; one model's fields: https://pixeldojo.ai/llm/{apiId}.txt. Omit for seedream-5, which makes still images only; name a video model to get a video.

preset.description: Preset slug that seeds the running model's settings; explicit fields and params override it. Each preset belongs to one model (browse them by model at https://pixeldojo.ai/presets), so set `model` to that preset's model: a slug the running model has no preset for is rejected with a 400 before any charge.

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. "1:1", "16:9", "9:16". Snapped to the nearest ratio the model supports, and dropped if the model has no aspect_ratio field.

duration.description: Video length in seconds. Snapped or clamped to what the model allows, and dropped if the model has no duration field. Required for grok-video-extend (the extension length).

resolution.description: Output resolution when the model supports it (e.g. "480p", "720p", "1080p", "4k"). Snapped to the nearest tier the model offers, and dropped if the model has no resolution field. Lower tiers cost fewer credits.

image_url.description: Reference still for image-to-image / image-to-video. A clip URL (.mp4/.mov/.webm) or an audio track URL (.mp3/.wav/.m4a/...) here is detected by extension and routed as that kind of media instead.

video_url.description: Source video clip to animate / restyle / extend. Use this for videos; image_url is for still frames. With no model, a clip runs on seedance-2-reference; a named model with no clip input is swapped for it and the result says so.

params.description: Advanced settings for the model that runs this, named exactly as that model documents them (e.g. {"resolution": "1080p", "seed": 42}). Set `model` in the same call: field names differ per model, so params without one are refused. Applied last, so these override anything derived from the other inputs. An invalid field comes back named with its allowed values and nothing is charged, so fix it and call again.

image_urls.description: Multiple reference image URLs for models that accept a reference set (character + wardrobe + location, for example). Single-reference models use the first and ignore the rest.

image_paths.description: Multiple absolute local file paths (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM, MOV), each uploaded to 24h temp storage and used as a reference, same rules as image_urls.

image_path.description: Absolute local file path to a reference image or clip (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM, MOV; no audio). The skill uploads it to 24h temp storage and uses the URL as image_url. Ignored when image_url is also set.

tools.name: pixeldojo_edit
tools.description: Edit an existing image with a text instruction. Defaults to wan-2.7-image-edit; pass `model` to pick another edit-capable apiId. Supports up to 9 reference images for multi-image composition. For reference images: pass image_url(s) for hosted URLs or image_path(s) for absolute local file paths (skill uploads to 24h temp storage automatically).

prompt.description: Edit instruction. Write @Name to use a character or element the user saved in Character Studio ("@Mara on a beach"): its photos are attached automatically on models that take reference images. pixeldojo_library source=characters lists them.

image_url.description: Single image to edit. Ignored when image_urls is set; pass image_urls for multi-image edits.

image_urls.description: Multiple reference images (1-9), most important first. Models that take fewer keep the first ones and the result says how many were dropped.

image_path.description: Absolute local image path (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF). Skill uploads it (24h temp storage) and edits the resulting URL. Ignored when image_url or image_paths is set.

image_paths.description: Multiple absolute local image paths (1-9). Each is uploaded to 24h temp storage and appended after any image_urls.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio, e.g. "1:1", "16:9", "match_input_image". Snapped to the nearest ratio the model supports, and dropped if the model has no aspect_ratio field.

params.description: Advanced settings for the model that runs this, named exactly as that model documents them (e.g. {"resolution": "1080p", "seed": 42}). Set `model` in the same call: field names differ per model, so params without one are refused. Applied last, so these override anything derived from the other inputs. An invalid field comes back named with its allowed values and nothing is charged, so fix it and call again.

tools.name: pixeldojo_character
tools.description: Generate or edit consistent characters across shots. Pass reference_image_urls (up to 9) to lock identity — send every photo of the person you have, since more angles hold the face far better than one. Defaults to seedream-5.

prompt.description: The shot to render: scene, pose, wardrobe, framing. The references supply the identity.

model.description: One of: seedream-5, seedream-4, seedream-5-flash, google-nano-banana, wan-2.7-image-edit, qwen-3-pro, qwen-image-2.0-pro. Defaults to seedream-5.

reference_image_url.description: Single still of the character. Ignored when reference_image_urls is set; prefer that, since more angles lock the face better.

reference_image_urls.description: All reference stills for this shot (1-9), most important first. Multiple angles of the same person lock the face far better than one photo. Models that take fewer keep the first ones and the result says how many were dropped. Required for wan-2.7-image-edit; clips and audio are refused.

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. "1:1", "16:9", "9:16". Snapped to the nearest ratio the model supports, and dropped for models with no aspect_ratio field (including the default seedream-5, which sizes by image_size: set that in params with an explicit model).

params.description: Advanced settings for the model that runs this, named exactly as that model documents them (e.g. {"resolution": "1080p", "seed": 42}). Set `model` in the same call: field names differ per model, so params without one are refused. Applied last, so these override anything derived from the other inputs. An invalid field comes back named with its allowed values and nothing is charged, so fix it and call again.

tools.name: pixeldojo_storyboard
tools.description: Generate one short video clip (a single shot, not a multi-panel storyboard) from a scene brief. A text-only brief runs on veo-3.1-fast unless `model` names another allowed video model. With image_url (reference still) or video_url (source clip) and no `model`, it runs on seedance-2-reference, with the same reference routing as pixeldojo_generate. For a multi-shot film with dialogue and a soundtrack, use pixeldojo_film.

brief.description: Scene brief: setting, action, camera, mood. Sent to the video model as its prompt.

model.description: One of: veo-3.1-fast, veo-3.1-standard, kling-video-v3-standard-text, seedance-2-high, seedance-2-reference. Defaults to veo-3.1-fast, or seedance-2-reference when image_url or video_url is given.

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. "16:9", "9:16", "1:1". Snapped to the nearest ratio the model supports, and dropped if the model has no aspect_ratio field.

duration.description: Clip length in seconds. Snapped or clamped to what the model allows.

image_url.description: Reference still to build the shot from (character, product, location). A clip or audio URL here is detected by extension and routed as that kind of media.

video_url.description: Source clip to work from. Use this for videos; image_url is for stills. A named model with no clip input is swapped for seedance-2-reference and the result says so.

params.description: Advanced settings for the model that runs this, named exactly as that model documents them (e.g. {"resolution": "1080p", "seed": 42}). Set `model` in the same call: field names differ per model, so params without one are refused. Applied last, so these override anything derived from the other inputs. An invalid field comes back named with its allowed values and nothing is charged, so fix it and call again.

tools.name: pixeldojo_upscale
tools.description: Enhance an image or video. Magnific (default) supports configurable scale_factor and creativity; face-enhance for portraits; video-upscaler (FlashVSR, up to 4K) for clips — pass video_url plus video_duration in seconds.

image_url.description: Source image to upscale (image models). A clip URL here (.mp4/.mov/.webm) is treated as video_url.

video_url.description: Source video clip (MP4, max 500 MB). Routes to video-upscaler when no model is named; needs video_duration.

model.description: Defaults to magnific-upscaler, or video-upscaler when the source is a clip. face-enhance is for portraits.

scale_factor.description: Image models only. magnific-upscaler snaps to the nearest of 2/4/8/16 (default 2); creative-upscale clamps to 1-10 (default 2); face-enhance clamps to 1-8 (default 4).

creativity.description: magnific-upscaler only: sent unchanged as its creativity setting, an integer from -10 to 10 (default 0; lower preserves the source, higher invents more detail).

video_duration.description: video-upscaler only, required there: source clip length in seconds. It sets the cost (1 credit per second).

target_resolution.description: video-upscaler only: output resolution. Defaults to 1080p.

tools.name: pixeldojo_audio
tools.description: Generate audio: speech, multi-character dialogue, sound effects, and background music from one prompt (Seed Audio 1.0 by default; plain text-to-speech available). Voice cloning takes hosted reference clip URLs in audio_urls; local audio files are not accepted. Returns an audio URL, or a jobId for pixeldojo_status.

prompt.description: seed-audio: a script to speak, or a scene description (dialogue, sound effects, music), up to 2048 characters; refer to audio_urls clips in order as @Audio1..@Audio3. text-to-speech: the exact text to speak, up to 10,000 characters.

model.description: seed-audio (default): speech, multi-voice dialogue, effects and music in one clip, and voice cloning from audio_urls. text-to-speech: plain narration with preset voices.

voice.description: text-to-speech only: voice preset (e.g. Wise_Woman, Calm_Woman, Friendly_Person; default Wise_Woman). seed-audio ignores it: describe the voice in the prompt, or clone one with audio_urls.

audio_urls.description: seed-audio only: up to 3 hosted reference clips (wav, mp3, pcm or ogg_opus, 30s / 10MB max each) for voice cloning, referenced in the prompt as @Audio1..@Audio3. Local audio files cannot be uploaded; pass URLs. Ignored by text-to-speech.

output_format.description: Output format. seed-audio: mp3 (default), wav, pcm, ogg_opus. text-to-speech: mp3 (default), wav, flac, pcm.

tools.name: pixeldojo_library
tools.description: Search your Library, newest first. source=media (default): saved media (permanent) and recent API/MCP generations (deleted 1 hour after they finish), as URLs to reuse as references. source=characters: saved Character Studio characters and elements, each usable as @Name in any prompt.

source.description: media (default): saved media and recent generations. characters: the saved Character Studio characters, products, outfits, locations, props and styles. Write @Name in any prompt to use one.

q.description: Substring match against the prompt that produced the asset. Omit to list the newest items.

model.description: Only assets from this model apiId.

tools.name: pixeldojo_save
tools.description: Save a generated image or video into the user's My Media library permanently ("save this", "keep it"). Results otherwise expire 1 hour after they finish. Pass the result URL; it is safety-checked before it is kept.

url.description: The result URL to keep (image or video from a PixelDojo job).

prompt.description: The prompt that produced it, so it is findable in the library later.

tool_name.description: Model apiId that produced it, when known.

modality.description: Output type, when the URL does not make it obvious.

job_id.description: The jobId that produced it, when known.

tools.name: pixeldojo_save_character
tools.description: Save a character (a person, from 3-5 photos) or an element (product, outfit, location, prop, style) to the user's Character Studio library. Afterwards write @Name in any prompt to use it. List saved ones with pixeldojo_library source=characters.

name.description: What to call it. Used as @Name in prompts afterwards.

kind.description: character (default), product, outfit, location, object (a prop) or style.

image_urls.description: Photos of it. For a person, 3 to 5 clear photos from different angles. Required for a character.

description.description: Optional appearance notes, or the scene text for an element without photos.

tools.name: pixeldojo_save_workflow
tools.description: Save a named multi-step skill chain (generate → edit → upscale …). String args may contain {{input.<key>}} and {{prev}} placeholders. Saving to an existing name overwrites it.

name.description: Kebab-case handle, 2-41 chars (e.g. "product-launch-pack"). Saving to an existing name overwrites it.

description.description: Optional note on what the workflow does (max 500 chars).

skill.description: Tool this step runs. Steps run in order when the workflow runs, and each is charged at that tool's own rate.

args.description: That tool's own arguments, exactly as you would pass them calling it directly. Any string value, at any depth, may contain {{input.<key>}} (filled from pixeldojo_run_workflow inputs) or {{prev}} (the first asset URL the previous step produced).

steps.description: The chain, 1-8 steps, run in order. Saving charges nothing; running charges each step.

tools.name: pixeldojo_run_workflow
tools.description: Run a saved workflow by name. Pass inputs for its {{input.<key>}} placeholders; each step feeds the next via {{prev}}.

inputs.description: String values for the workflow's {{input.<key>}} placeholders, e.g. {"product": "red sneaker"}. A step whose placeholder has no value stops the run before that step.

tools.name: pixeldojo_list_workflows
tools.description: List your saved workflows with step counts and run totals.

tools.name: pixeldojo_status
tools.description: Check once, without waiting, on a jobId that a generation tool returned instead of an asset after its 30s wait. Free. Returns asset URLs when complete, the failure reason if it failed, or the current state and job age if still running. Campaign ids go to pixeldojo_campaign_status; films report progress through pixeldojo_film with action "status".

jobId.description: The jobId a generation tool returned instead of an asset (a job_... id).

tools.name: pixeldojo_from_url
tools.description: Extract a product profile from a product page URL: name, description, image URLs (the first three are listed), and the extraction method used. Works on Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, or any page with JSON-LD / OpenGraph product metadata. Free. pixeldojo_campaign and pixeldojo_ad accept a product URL and run this extraction themselves; call this directly to check the product data first, or to reuse its images in other tools.

url.description: Product page URL. Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, or any page with JSON-LD / OpenGraph product metadata.

tools.name: pixeldojo_upload
tools.description: Upload a local image, video or audio file (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF up to 50MB; MP4, WebM, MOV up to 200MB; MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, FLAC up to 50MB) and get back a public URL that expires after 24 hours. Free. Pass an audio URL as song_url to pixeldojo_film for a music video. Pass the URL as image_url (stills) or video_url (clips) to tools that take hosted URLs only, such as pixeldojo_character, pixeldojo_storyboard and pixeldojo_upscale. pixeldojo_generate, pixeldojo_edit and pixeldojo_ad take local paths directly and need no separate upload.

path.description: Absolute local file path. Allowed: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF (≤50MB), MP4, WebM, MOV (≤200MB) or MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, FLAC audio (≤50MB). Returns a public URL on the temp CDN; auto-expires after 24h.

tools.name: pixeldojo_ad
tools.description: Marketing Studio: turn a product into a rendered video ad with voiceover. Requires `product_url` (name, description and images are extracted), or `product_name` plus product_image_urls / product_image_paths. Pick a `style` slug (default ugc-testimonial; full catalog at GET https://pixeldojo.ai/api/v1/marketing/presets), and optionally add presenter reference images, a location, a hook, and the exact spoken script. Returns the video URL, or a jobId to check with pixeldojo_status.

style.description: Ad style slug (default ugc-testimonial). Catalog: GET /api/v1/marketing/presets — e.g. ugc-testimonial, unboxing-reveal, unboxing-asmr, virtual-try-on, street-style, mirror-fit-check, pro-try-on, product-showcase, macro-details, secret-hack-reveal, crush-test, hyper-motion, before-after, day-in-the-life, the-gift, tv-spot, gadget-saved-me, selfie-testimonial, direct-to-camera, pack-an-order, mystery-box.

product_url.description: Product page URL. Name, description, and images are extracted automatically. Pass this, or product_name plus product images; when set, the product_* fields are ignored.

product_name.description: Product name. Required with product images when there is no product_url.

product_image_urls.description: Up to 5 hosted product photos (no product_url case).

product_image_paths.description: Up to 5 absolute local product image paths; uploaded to 24h temp storage automatically.

character_image_urls.description: Presenter reference images for a consistent on-camera character.

character_image_paths.description: Absolute local presenter image paths; uploaded to 24h temp storage automatically.

location_description.description: Where the ad takes place ("a sunlit Parisian cafe"). Text is enough.

location_image_url.description: Optional reference photo of the location.

hook.description: The opening visual beat (first 1-2 seconds). Omit to use the style default.

script.description: The exact spoken line, voiced word for word. Omit and the presenter improvises.

quality.description: Render tier. Omitted or unsupported by the ad engine, the engine's default tier is used.

resolution.description: 1080p/4k require quality "high"; without it, or when the engine lacks the value, the engine default resolution is used.

aspect_ratio.description: Defaults to the style's own aspect ratio; a value the engine does not support falls back to it.

duration.description: Ad length in seconds. Defaults to the style's length; clamped to what the engine allows.

tools.name: pixeldojo_campaign
tools.description: Generate a coherent product launch package (hero image + N lifestyle variants + optional vertical video) from one URL or product profile. Composes hero / lifestyle / video models server-side; returns assets in one call or a handoff with campaignId to poll via pixeldojo_campaign_status.

productUrl.description: Product page URL; name, description and images are extracted automatically. Pass this or `product` (one is required); when both are set, productUrl wins.

product.description: Manual product profile, used when productUrl is omitted.

images.description: Up to 5 hosted product photo URLs.

tone.description: Optional creative direction ("premium minimalist", "playful Y2K"), threaded through every prompt.

variants.description: Lifestyle shots in addition to the hero (default 4).

includeVideo.description: Also render a launch video (default true).

videoMode.description: Launch video styling: lifestyle (default), cgi, ugc, or skip for no video.

tools.name: pixeldojo_campaign_status
tools.description: Poll a campaign by campaignId returned from pixeldojo_campaign. Returns assets when every sub-job is done, or a handoff describing what is still in flight.

campaignId.description: Campaign id returned from a prior pixeldojo_campaign handoff.

tools.name: pixeldojo_film
tools.description: Make a finished short film from one idea: screenplay, storyboard frames (AI-reviewed), video clips with spoken dialogue, scene-synced soundtrack, stitched export. Or a music video: pass song_path (a local file) or song_url (your own PixelDojo upload from pixeldojo_upload, never a third-party link) with optional lyrics; the film is cut to that song, each clip lip-synced to its slice on the studio music video engine, and no score is composed: the export plays the song. Every named character must be cast (cast: your own images, a portrait prompt, or a Character Studio character) before frames render; cast entries can also replace or remove someone. Phased: plan is free; cast; produce starts charged generation; status advances production (poll every ~30s); redo renders a new take of chosen shots and status re-exports.

idea.description: Plan step: one-to-three sentence film idea. The studio writes the screenplay (free). Provide idea or script. Keep the user's own words for who each character is, including their gender and pronouns ("she", "he") and species; the writer has nothing else to go on.

script.description: Plan step: a full screenplay (sluglines, action lines, dialogue) to plan instead of an idea.

look.description: Plan step: visual style carried through frames, clips and soundtrack. Story looks: live-action, anime, 3d-animation, noir, horror, sci-fi, documentary, western, romance, romantic-comedy, comedy (default live-action). Music video looks: rap-video, neon-club, stage-performance, retro-camcorder, y2k-pop, moody-rnb, rock-grit, dream-pop, k-pop (default rap-video).

song_url.description: Plan step, music video mode: URL of the song. It must be your own PixelDojo upload (from pixeldojo_upload or /api/v1/upload); a third-party link is refused. Makes a music video cut to this song, every clip lip-synced to its slice of it, rendered on the studio music video engine. idea (or script) describes the visuals. No score is composed: the song is the soundtrack.

song_path.description: Plan step, music video mode: absolute local path to the song (MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, FLAC up to 50MB). Uploaded for you; use instead of song_url.

song_duration_sec.description: Plan step, music video mode (optional): the song length in seconds. Omit it and the studio measures the song.

lyrics.description: Plan step, music video mode (optional): the song lyrics, so shots land on the right lines.

aspect.description: Plan step: frame aspect ratio. Default 16:9.

length.description: Plan step: target length. Default 60s. Ignored for a music video, whose length is the song.

pacing.description: Plan step: 'story' (default) plays every shot's action whole, for any narrative film. 'trailer' cuts it like a trailer, promo or sizzle: most shots stay on screen 1.5-3 seconds. Ignored for a music video.

film_id.description: The film_id returned by the plan step. Required for produce, status and redo; with it, action "plan" is treated as "status".

action.description: plan (default, free): writes the script and plans shots, returns film_id, a cost estimate, and any characters still to cast. cast: casts, replaces or removes characters on an existing film (pass film_id and cast). produce (charged): starts rendering frames; refused until every named character is cast. status: advances production one step and reports progress; call it every ~30s until it returns the finished film URL. redo (charged): renders a new take of the shots listed in `shots`, on a film in production or already finished; then call status, which saves the new take and cuts a new export with it.

shots.description: Redo only: the shots to render again, by the labels status and the finished film report ("2.3" is scene 2, shot 3), or by shot id.

redo.description: Redo only: 'clip' (default) renders a new take of the clip from the same storyboard frame, the fix for a glitch, bad motion or lip sync. 'frame' paints a new frame first (and then a new clip from it), the fix for a wrong look, face or composition. Each is charged like any render of that shot. To change what a shot shows, edit it on the storyboard.

cast.description: Cast members, one per named character. Every named character must be cast before frames render, so faces, ages and species hold in every shot. Pass them on the plan call (the script then stars them by name) or later with action "cast" using the names the plan reports. Each entry: name, plus ONE of image_urls (your own photos of an adult, made into a character), prompt (a portrait is generated from it, charged like any image), or character_id (a Character Studio character). An entry with only a name uses your Character Studio character of that name. A name that is already cast is left alone unless the entry sets replace: true, which hands that part (every shot, outfit and voice) to the new cast member. remove: true with only the name takes that cast member off the film; the part then needs a new cast member before frames render. replace and remove work until the shots of that cast member are rendered; after that, recast on the storyboard, where the frames that show them can be redone.

name.description: The character name as the film uses it (e.g. "Harlan").

image_urls.description: Your own https photos of the character (1-8). PixelDojo uploads work; they are copied to permanent storage.

prompt.description: A description to generate the portrait from: species if not human, gender, adult age, look and outfit (e.g. "man in his late 50s, grey mustache, sunburnt, red windbreaker").

replace.description: Swap out whoever already plays this name for the image_urls, prompt or character_id given here, before their shots are rendered. Without it, an already-cast name is left unchanged.

remove.description: Take whoever plays this name off the film and every shot (free), before their shots are rendered. Give only the name.

soundtrack.description: Read on status calls once all clips are ready. scene-synced (default): one musical section per scene. flat: one cohesive bed. none: export without music. Ignored for a music video, which always exports with its song.

music_job_id.description: The music_job_id from the previous status reply while the score is composing. A status call without it, once all clips are ready and no score is attached, starts and charges for a new score.

tools.name: pixeldojo_video
tools.description: Video Studio verbs for an existing clip, on the same engines the studio uses. verb=change restyles or edits a clip (prompt + video_url, optional reference images). verb=move puts a character image into a driving video's motion (video_url + image_url + video_duration). verb=extend continues a clip forward, or backward on the default engine (prompt + video_url, optional duration and direction). Omit `model` for the studio default; engine-specific settings go in `params` with an explicit `model`. To make a new video, use pixeldojo_generate. Returns asset URLs, or a jobId for pixeldojo_status when the job outlasts the 30s wait. Local files: video_path / image_path (uploaded to 24h temp storage first).

verb.description: change = restyle or edit an existing clip; move = put a character image into a driving video (motion transfer / character swap); extend = continue a clip forward (or backward on the default engine).

prompt.description: What to change, how the character should move, or what happens next. Required for change and extend. Optional for move (wan-video-character-swap ignores it). @Name uses a character or element the user saved in Character Studio (photos attached automatically).

video_url.description: The source clip (change, extend) or the driving motion clip (move). Required.

video_path.description: Absolute local path to the source clip (MP4, WebM, MOV). Uploaded to 24h temp storage and used as video_url.

image_url.description: The character image (move, required) or a reference image (change, optional; some engines take none).

image_urls.description: More reference images for change engines that take a set. Move uses the first image only.

image_path.description: Absolute local path to the character or reference image. Uploaded to 24h temp storage and used as image_url.

model.description: Video Studio engine for this verb. Omit for the default. change: seedance-2-5-video-edit, flux-video-edit, kling-video-edit, wan-video-edit, seedance-video-edit, happyhorse-1.0-video-edit, xai-video-edit (default seedance-2-5-video-edit); move: kling-motion-control, wan-video-character-swap (default kling-motion-control); extend: seedance-2-5-video-edit, wan-2.7-i2v, grok-video-extend (default seedance-2-5-video-edit). A model not on the verb's list is replaced by the default and the result says so.

video_duration.description: The source clip's length in seconds. Required by every engine except the change/extend default and grok-video-extend, since it sets their credit cost.

duration.description: Extend only: output length in seconds (default engine 4-30, wan-2.7-i2v 2-15 total), or seconds added on grok-video-extend (2-10). Ignored by change and move, which keep the source length.

direction.description: Extend only. backward adds footage before the clip; only the default engine supports it.

params.description: Advanced settings for the model that runs this, named exactly as that model documents them (e.g. {"resolution": "1080p", "seed": 42}). Set `model` in the same call: field names differ per model, so params without one are refused. Applied last, so these override anything derived from the other inputs. An invalid field comes back named with its allowed values and nothing is charged, so fix it and call again.

tools.name: pixeldojo_episode
tools.description: Make a finished narrated faceless video (explainer, history, kids story) from one topic: script, scene visuals, AI narration, music bed, stitched export saved to the Library. Phased: create is free and returns a credit quote; produce is charged and advances one step per call (poll every ~30s until it returns the video URL); status is free.

action.description: create (default, free): writes the script and scene plan, returns episode_id and the credit quote. produce (charged): advances production one step (narration, scene renders, music, export, save) and reports what that step cost; call it every ~30s until it returns the finished video URL. status (free): progress only.

topic.description: Create step: what the episode is about, 8 to 400 characters.

episode_id.description: The episode_id from the create step. Required for produce and status.

category.description: Create step: tone of the script. Default education.

style.description: Create step: visual style of every scene. Default editorial-motion.

length_seconds.description: Create step: target length in seconds. Default 120.

voice.description: Create step: narrator voice id from the text-to-speech tool (e.g. Wise_Woman, Deep_Voice_Man, Friendly_Person). Default Wise_Woman.

engine.description: Create step (optional): render every scene with one engine. omni-draft: fast, cheap motion preview. omni-final: full quality motion with sound. still-motion: one illustration per scene, gently panned, cheapest. Default: the style picks.

music.description: Create step: add a music bed under the narration. Default true.

title.description: Create step (optional): episode title. Defaults to the topic.

instructions: Pixel Dojo generates images, video, audio and short films from one catalog of AI models, billed in credits from the connected Pixel Dojo account. A job that runs past the 30-second wait returns a jobId to check later; check it rather than submitting again, since every new submission is charged. Generated asset URLs are deleted one hour after they are created: pixeldojo_save keeps one in the user's My Media permanently (after a safety check), and finished films stay in the account library. In any prompt, @Name uses a character, product, outfit, location, prop or style the user saved in Character Studio: its photos are attached automatically. pixeldojo_library source=characters lists them, and pixeldojo_save_character saves a new one from 3 to 5 photos.
